Corner Loaf bakes 100 loaves a day, each using 400 grams of flour. Golden Crust bakes 97 loaves a day, each using 10% more flour than one of Corner Loaf's loaves. Corner Loaf opens at 6 a.m. every day. Flour comes only in whole 10-kg sacks at $23 per sack. A 10-kg sack of rye flour costs $26. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 7 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

Ashford and Hollin are 552 km apart by rail. A freight train leaves Ashford for Hollin at 7:30 a.m. and runs at a steady 96 km/h. A passenger train leaves Hollin for Ashford at 8:15 a.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1600 meters per minute. The freight train has 11 carriages. A one-way ticket between the two towns costs $38. Neither train stops on the way. How many kilometers from Hollin are the trains when they pass each other?

A survey asked 500 residents about three things. The survey took 5 weeks to complete. 18% of them own a car, 23% own a bicycle, and 27% own a scooter. The average age of those surveyed was 34. Also, 31 own both a car and a bicycle, 36 own both a car and a scooter, and 52 own both a bicycle and a scooter; each of these counts includes the 20 residents who own all three. How many of the 500 residents own exactly one of the three?

A bakery pays three staff by the hour: Diego earns $28 an hour, Amara earns $18 an hour, and Mateo earns $26 an hour. The bakery serves about 157 customers a day. Any hours beyond 40 in a week are paid at time-and-a-half, that is 150% of the person's normal hourly rate. This week Diego worked 44 hours, Amara worked 5 hours fewer than Diego, and Mateo worked 564 minutes on each of 5 days. Amara has worked there for 4 years. Staff get 10% off anything they buy at the bakery. How many dollars does the bakery pay the three of them in total for this week?

Elstow and Ashford are 331 km apart by rail. A local train leaves Elstow for Ashford at 10:40 a.m. and runs at a steady 68 km/h. The local train has 9 carriages. A night train leaves Ashford for Elstow at 11:55 a.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1600 meters per minute. The night train is carrying 484 passengers. The local train left from platform 4. Neither train stops on the way. How many kilometers from Ashford are the trains when they pass each other?

A rental shop has only bicycles, tricycles and quad bikes for hire. Quad bikes are charged $11 per hour each. Altogether there are 25 vehicles with 71 wheels, and exactly 20% of the vehicles are quad bikes. The shop has room for 84 vehicles. Bicycles are charged $4 per hour each. The shop opens at 5 a.m. How many dollars are collected from the bicycles if every one of them is rented out for 7 hours?

Stone Oven bakes 68 loaves a day, each using 420 grams of flour. Daily Bread bakes 35 loaves a day, each using 50% more flour than one of Stone Oven's loaves. Stone Oven opens at 6 a.m. every day. Daily Bread sells each loaf for $4. A 10-kg sack of rye flour costs $23. Flour comes only in whole 10-kg sacks at $20 per sack. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 9 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

A courier firm runs two delivery vans. This month the small van drove 300 km on each of its 16 working days, using 9 liters of diesel per 100 km. The large van drove 125 km on each of its 21 working days and normally uses 16 liters per 100 km, but on 9 of those days it carried heavy loads and used 25% more fuel than normal. The small van is 6 years old. Diesel costs $1.68 per liter. Each working day starts at 8 a.m. How many liters of diesel did the two vans use altogether this month?

A rental shop has only bicycles, tricycles and quad bikes for hire. Altogether there are 16 vehicles with 45 wheels, and exactly 25% of the vehicles are quad bikes. The shop opens at 7 a.m. Bicycles are charged $3 per hour each. Quad bikes are charged $11 per hour each. How many dollars are collected from the bicycles if every one of them is rented out for 4 hours?

A bike shop pays three staff by the hour: Kofi earns $32 an hour, Nadia earns $24 an hour, and Maya earns $30 an hour. Nadia has worked there for 2 years. Staff get 20% off anything they buy at the bike shop. The bike shop serves about 299 customers a day. Any hours beyond 40 in a week are paid at time-and-a-half, that is 150% of the person's normal hourly rate. This week Kofi worked 43 hours, Nadia worked 3 hours fewer than Kofi, and Maya worked 576 minutes on each of 5 days. How many dollars does the bike shop pay the three of them in total for this week?

Hollin and Ashford are 309 km apart by rail. The passenger train is carrying 595 passengers. A local train leaves Hollin for Ashford at 2:20 p.m. and runs at a steady 60 km/h. A passenger train leaves Ashford for Hollin at 2:35 p.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1800 meters per minute. The local train has 11 carriages. Neither train stops on the way. A one-way ticket between the two towns costs $23. How many kilometers from Ashford are the trains when they pass each other?

A rental shop has only bicycles, tricycles and quad bikes for hire. The shop opens at 6 a.m. Quad bikes are charged $10 per hour each. The shop has room for 105 vehicles. Altogether there are 70 vehicles with 186 wheels, and exactly 10% of the vehicles are quad bikes. Tricycles are charged $3 per hour each. How many dollars are collected from the tricycles if every one of them is rented out for 2 hours?

Kofi needs 14 sketchbooks and 8 sets of paints and will buy the whole order at one of two shops. At Corner Store, a sketchbook costs $10 and a set of paints costs $25, and the whole bill gets 30% off at the till. Bright Mart is 3 km farther from Kofi's home. At Bright Mart, a sketchbook costs $8 and a set of paints costs $22 with no discount on the bill, but every fifth sketchbook in an order is free. Last month Bright Mart had 30% off everything. Corner Store also sells brushes at $2 each, but Kofi does not need any. By buying the whole order at the cheaper shop, how many dollars does Kofi save compared with the other shop?

At 6 p.m., the upper tank contains 530 liters of water and the lower tank contains 706 liters. Each tank can hold up to 900 liters. Water from the mains costs 2 cents per liter. From 6 p.m. on, a valve drains the lower tank at 180 liters per hour, and a crack in the upper tank leaks 3 liters per minute. 7 minutes after 6 p.m., a hose starts filling the upper tank at 11 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

A survey asked 500 employees about three things. A similar survey last year asked 350 employees. 25% of them speak Spanish, 21% speak German, and 17% speak Japanese. Also, 45 speak both Spanish and German, 40 speak both Spanish and Japanese, and 27 speak both German and Japanese; each of these counts includes the 12 employees who speak all three. The survey took 5 weeks to complete. How many of the 500 employees speak exactly two of the three?

Stone Oven bakes 120 loaves a day, each using 420 grams of flour. Corner Loaf bakes 100 loaves a day, each using 50% more flour than one of Stone Oven's loaves. Flour comes only in whole 20-kg sacks at $14 per sack. Corner Loaf sells each loaf for $7. Each loaf bakes for 33 minutes. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 14 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

At 8 a.m., the old tank contains 780 liters of water and the new tank contains 1382 liters. The new tank stands 3 meters tall. From 8 a.m. on, a valve drains the new tank at 540 liters per hour, and a crack in the old tank leaks 1 liters per minute. The hose is 23 meters long. Water from the mains costs 4 cents per liter. 12 minutes after 8 a.m., a hose starts filling the old tank at 15 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

4 years ago, the ages of Liam, Ravi and Lucas added up to 15. Ravi is 36 months older than Lucas. Liam is twice as old as Lucas. Lucas is 152 cm tall. The family moved to their current house 3 years ago. What will the sum of Liam's and Ravi's ages be 2 years from now?

A bike shop pays three staff by the hour: Omar earns $30 an hour, Greta earns $32 an hour, and Elena earns $20 an hour. Any hours beyond 40 in a week are paid at time-and-a-half, that is 150% of the person's normal hourly rate. Greta has worked there for 5 years. Omar's shift usually starts at 6 a.m. This week Omar worked 46 hours, Greta worked 9 hours fewer than Omar, and Elena worked 420 minutes on each of 5 days. How many dollars does the bike shop pay the three of them in total for this week?

At noon, the north tank contains 300 liters of water and the south tank contains 775 liters. Each tank can hold up to 1000 liters. From noon on, a valve drains the south tank at 540 liters per hour, and a crack in the north tank leaks 4 liters per minute. 8 minutes after noon, a hose starts filling the north tank at 10 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. Water from the mains costs 3 cents per liter. The south tank stands 2 meters tall. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

Omar is twice as old as Sofia. Their grandmother is 80 years old. Leila is 24 months older than Sofia. Sofia is 159 cm tall. Omar's dog is 5 years old. 4 years ago, the ages of Omar, Leila and Sofia added up to 26. What will the sum of Omar's and Leila's ages be 4 years from now?

Elena needs 12 notebooks and 10 packs of pens and will buy the whole order at one of two shops. Bright Mart is 3 km farther from Elena's home. At Bright Mart, a notebook costs $4 and a pack of pens costs $35 with no discount on the bill, but every third notebook in an order is free. Last month Bright Mart had 35% off everything. At QuickShop, a notebook costs $5 and a pack of pens costs $35, and the whole bill gets 40% off at the till. By buying the whole order at the cheaper shop, how many dollars does Elena save compared with the other shop?

An office has three printers: Printer A prints 27 pages per minute, Printer B prints 21 pages per minute, and Printer C prints 540 pages per hour. Printer B is 5 years old. The print job is 1860 pages. At 2:20 p.m., Printer A and Printer B start on it together. At 2:52 p.m., Printer B is switched off for maintenance and Printer C is switched on, and A and C finish the print job together. The print job is due by 4:05 p.m.. How many pages does Printer A print for this print job?

6 years ago, the ages of Amara, Lucas and Omar added up to 54. The family moved to their current house 3 years ago. Amara is four times as old as Omar. Omar is 118 cm tall. Lucas is 72 months older than Omar. What will the sum of Amara's and Lucas's ages be 4 years from now?

The morning shift, the day shift and the night shift are selling raffle tickets at $2 each to raise money for the children's hospital. The morning shift has 24 members. The morning shift sells 46 tickets. Last year's raffle raised $1167. The day shift sells 20 more tickets than the morning shift. The night shift sells 24 fewer than twice as many tickets as the day shift. The printer charged 12 cents for every ticket printed, and 400 tickets were printed in total, including the unsold ones. The printing bill is paid out of the ticket money, the organizers also keep 15% of the total ticket sales for next year's event, and everything left goes to the children's hospital. How many dollars go to the children's hospital?

An office has three printers: Printer A prints 15 pages per minute, Printer B prints 18 pages per minute, and Printer C prints 1440 pages per hour. The site has 28 staff on duty. The print job is 726 pages. At 10:30 a.m., Printer A and Printer B start on it together. The print job is due by 11:29 a.m.. Printer B is 6 years old. At 10:39 a.m., Printer B is switched off for maintenance and Printer C is switched on, and A and C finish the print job together. How many pages does Printer A print for this print job?

Three lighthouses along one coast flash together at the same instant at dusk. The north light flashes once every 36 seconds. A fourth lighthouse, which flashes every 72 seconds, is switched off for repairs. The harbor light flashes once every 1 minute. The harbor light stands 55 meters tall. A ferry leaves the harbor every 39 minutes. The island light flashes once every 45 seconds. Counting that first moment, how many times do all three flash at the same instant during the first 17 minutes and 45 seconds?

A café pays three staff by the hour: Diego earns $14 an hour, Ravi earns $26 an hour, and Chen earns $18 an hour. The café serves about 308 customers a day. Any hours beyond 40 in a week are paid at time-and-a-half, that is 150% of the person's normal hourly rate. Ravi has worked there for 2 years. This week Diego worked 50 hours, Ravi worked 4 hours fewer than Diego, and Chen worked 690 minutes on each of 4 days. How many dollars does the café pay the three of them in total for this week?

A drinks factory has three bottling lines: Line A fills 28 bottles per minute, Line B fills 35 bottles per minute, and Line C fills 1080 bottles per hour. The order is 2924 bottles. At 10:30 a.m., Line A and Line B start on it together. At 11:04 a.m., Line B is switched off for maintenance and Line C is switched on, and A and C finish the order together. The order is due by 12:09 p.m.. Line D, which fills 16 bottles per minute, is out of service all day. The site has 8 staff on duty. How many bottles does Line A fill for this order?

Yusuf, Ivan, Chen, Omar and Greta collect marbles. Greta has 257 marbles. Chen has 23 more marbles than Greta. Omar has twice as many marbles as Ivan. Omar has 31 more marbles than Yusuf. Omar hopes to reach 800 marbles by next year. Ivan has 20% more marbles than Chen. Chen started collecting 5 years ago. How many marbles do Yusuf and Ivan have together?

The red team, the blue team and the green team are selling raffle tickets at $2 each to raise money for the animal shelter. The red team sells 53 tickets. The blue team sells 22 more tickets than the red team. The grand prize, a $195 bicycle, was donated by a local shop. The green team sells 18 fewer than twice as many tickets as the blue team. The printer charged 10 cents for every ticket printed, and 400 tickets were printed in total, including the unsold ones. Last year's raffle raised $1250. The red team has 31 members. The printing bill is paid out of the ticket money, the organizers also keep 30% of the total ticket sales for next year's event, and everything left goes to the animal shelter. How many dollars go to the animal shelter?

Hollin and Bramley are 256 km apart by rail. A local train leaves Hollin for Bramley at 11:25 a.m. and runs at a steady 112 km/h. A night train leaves Bramley for Hollin at 12:10 p.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1000 meters per minute. The night train is carrying 443 passengers. The local train left from platform 2. Neither train stops on the way. How many kilometers from Hollin are the trains when they pass each other?

Three warning beacons on a radio mast blink together at the same instant at midnight. The red beacon blinks once every 2 minutes. A plane passes overhead about every 36 minutes. The white beacon blinks once every 24 seconds. The mast is 27 meters tall. The amber beacon blinks once every 1 minute and 12 seconds. A fourth beacon, which blinks every 60 seconds, is switched off for repairs. Counting that first moment, how many times do all three blink at the same instant during the first 1 hour, 4 minutes and 49 seconds?
